headline: Lagarde says leading the Davos Forum "is one of the options" for her future
summary: Christine Lagarde said heading the World Economic Forum in Davos is one of the options for her future. Several media outlets have reported the possibility in recent months.
why: The World Economic Forum is the Geneva-based organisation that hosts the annual Davos meeting of business and political leaders. Lagarde is a former IMF managing director and current ECB president.
original_headline: Lagarde adelanta que dirigir el Foro de Davos "es una de las opciones" para su futuro
